items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I listened to some of his records. We copied a couple of things from him, too.

ctx.x: I listened to some of his records. We copied a couple of things from him, too. But actually, I didn't -- he didn't really knock me out like other bands I had really heard, you know, because they went together -- I liked that -- I kind of liked them arrangements and things

these cats was playing, you know what I mean? And the solos, like they took -- didn't impress me that much and even being unarranged, you know, I was less interested. But I'm not putting him down because he, you know, he had some nice things. But I would say the Midwest bands and the Texas bands, I thought, outswung, really, altogether. I thought they were better organized.
